create_Lipreading_model: create a Lipreading model with ResNet backbone for lipreading from video sequences
build_TCN_module: build a Temporal Convolutional Network module for processing sequential lipreading features
build_multiscale_tcn: build a Multiscale Multibranch TCN module with multiple kernel sizes for lipreading
run_Lipreading_forward: run the Lipreading model forward pass on video tensor input with sequence lengths
convert_3D_to_2D_tensor: convert a 3D lipreading tensor from batch-channel-time format to 2D flattened format
